newsitem.title: USA: Paul Harris closes stock offering.
newsitem.headline: Paul Harris closes stock offering.

text.p: Paul Harris Stores Inc said Friday it closed its public offering of 3,300,000 shares of its common stock at a price of $16 a share.
Of the shares sold, 500,000 shares were sold by the company and 2,800,000 were sold by a shareholder.
The company said it intends to add the proceeds of the shares it sold to its working capital and it will be available for general corporate purposes.

The underwriters of the public offering have options to purchase up to an additional 495,000 shares of common stock from the company to cover over-allotments. Such options are exercisable through June 13, 1997.

Paul Harris sells moderately priced sportswear and accessories sold under the Paul Harris Design private label. The company currently operates 221 stores located in 26 states and the District of Columbia.
